hauke.headline: Efficient, reliable, and highly recommended
hauke.quote: Starlight Visuals supported us in creating a CGI video for SmarAct Automation, with the goal of presenting our core competencies in a clear, professional, and visually engaging way. The collaboration was highly efficient and reliable from start to finish. We especially appreciated the fast response times, quick turnaround, strong communication, and dependable delivery of the final files. Our requirements were understood quickly and implemented professionally. We are very satisfied with the result and can confidently recommend Starlight Visuals for high-quality CGI and visual content projects.

jeremy.headline: From sketches to a finished helmet film
jeremy.quote: Working with Starlight Visuals was a great experience from start to finish. They didn't just create an animation they were involved throughout the entire process, from refining our initial sketches to supporting the CAD development and delivering a final helmet animation that brought our concept to life. What stood out most was how quickly they understood the product and translated technical details into visuals that were both accurate and engaging. The final presentation video gave us a professional way to showcase our helmet design to partners and stakeholders. They were responsive, easy to collaborate with, and genuinely cared about getting every detail right. I'd gladly recommend them to anyone looking for high-quality product animation and visualization.

raiv.headline: They genuinely cared about every character
raiv.quote: I really enjoyed working with the team. It felt like they genuinely cared about the project and wanted the characters to look and feel right. Communication was always easy, they were open to feedback, and every revision was handled without any hassle. Seeing our NSFW characters come to life was exciting.

ilija.headline: Clear visuals for electric vehicle technology
ilija.quote: They helped shape our PHR concept creatively and deliver amazing video making sure the visuals clearly communicate how our electric vehicle technology works. Their attention to detail, creativity, and willingness to iterate made the entire process smooth. The final animation gave us a much clearer way to present our product to partners and stakeholders.

luigi.headline: Exactly what we needed for M12 and B12
luigi.quote: We needed a clear way to show the differences between our M12 and B12 products, and Starlight Visuals delivered exactly what we were looking for. The animations were high quality, easy to understand, and captured every important detail.

jason.headline: Outstanding quality beyond what we imagined
jason.quote: The quality of the animation was outstanding. Starlight Visuals helped us present our product in a way that was clear, engaging, and memorable. The final presentation looked far better than we had imagined.

burkhard.headline: Made a complex product easy to explain
burkhard.quote: We knew our product was strong, but explaining it clearly to customers was always the challenge. The team at Starlight Visuals took the time to understand how everything works and turned it into an animation that made the message much easier to communicate. It looks professional, keeps people's attention, and helps us present the product with much more confidence. The whole process was straightforward, and they were easy to work with. We're very happy with the result.

robert.headline: Premium watch films beyond what we imagined
robert.quote: There was a clear vision for how we wanted our watches to be presented, but Starlight Visuals took it beyond what we imagined. They didn't just animate our product they captured the details, precision, and premium quality that define our brand. The final presentation gave our collection a level of sophistication that instantly elevated how customers perceived it. The entire process was smooth, collaborative, and professionally handled from start to finish.

aboutPage.metaDescription: Starlight Visuals is a world-class animation studio creating exceptional visual experiences across industrial product animation, game animation, product visualization, and 2D & 3D character animation.
aboutPage.label: Who We Are
aboutPage.p1: Starlight Visuals is a world-class animation studio creating exceptional visual experiences across industrial product animation, game animation, product visualization, and 2D & 3D character animation. We combine artistic excellence with cutting-edge technology to transform ideas into visuals that captivate, educate, and inspire. From engineering-driven industrial animations and photorealistic product renders to stylized cartoons, expressive character performances, and cinematic game sequences, we create animation that delivers both visual impact and meaningful results.
aboutPage.p2: Whether showcasing a product's innovation, bringing a game universe to life, or crafting memorable animated characters, every frame is designed with purpose and precision. Our multidisciplinary team of animators, technical artists, modelers, riggers, motion designers, and visual storytellers collaborates seamlessly to produce work that meets the highest creative and technical standards. We believe great animation does more than look beautiful, it communicates complex ideas, strengthens brands, and creates lasting emotional connections.
aboutPage.p3: We partner with manufacturers, product companies, game developers, creative agencies, and global brands to deliver premium animation for marketing, product launches, training, entertainment, advertising, and digital experiences. Every project is driven by innovation, craftsmanship, and an uncompromising commitment to quality. At Starlight Visuals, we don't simply animate, we engineer experiences, build unforgettable characters, and create visuals that move people and businesses forward.

accordionPage.title: QUESTIONS & ANSWERS
accordionPage.subtitle: Everything you need to know about working with us, from first brief to final delivery.

01.question: What types of projects do you work on?
01.answer: We produce animation, VFX, cinematics, motion graphics, product films, and brand films for film, series, advertising, and DTC brands. Briefs range from single hero assets to full campaign packages.

02.question: Where is Starlights Visuals based?
02.answer: We're a remote first studio with team members across multiple time zones. We collaborate with clients globally and deliver production ready assets through structured async workflows and live reviews.

03.question: How do I start a project?
03.answer: Reach out via the contact form with your brief, timeline, and reference links. We'll schedule a discovery call, scope the work, and send a proposal with milestones and deliverables.

01.question: What services do you offer?
01.answer: Our core services include 2D and 3D animation, VFX, character and concept art, motion graphics, product animation, and cinematic trailers. We can handle individual disciplines or full pipeline production.

02.question: Do you work with indie teams and large studios?
02.answer: Yes. We partner with indie creators, mid size studios, and global brands. Scope and team size flex to match your budget and timeline without compromising craft.

03.question: Can you match our existing art style?
03.answer: Absolutely. We start with style frames and a look development pass aligned to your brand guidelines or visual world before committing to full production.

01.question: What are typical timelines?
01.answer: Timelines depend on scope, a social cutdown may take one to two weeks, while a full cinematic can run four to eight weeks. We outline clear milestones in every proposal.

02.question: How do revisions work?
02.answer: Each milestone includes a defined number of revision rounds. We consolidate feedback into structured review sessions so changes stay efficient and on schedule.

03.question: What file formats do you deliver?
03.answer: We deliver format ready exports for your pipeline, MP4 and MOV for video, PNG and EXR sequences where needed, layered source files on request, and engine ready assets for real time projects.

blogPage.label: Studio journal
blogPage.subtitle: Thoughts on cinematic craft, production workflows, and building visuals that convert.
blogPage.postBody1: At Starlights Visuals, we treat every frame as a conversion opportunity, not just a beautiful image. This article expands on the thinking behind our {{category}} work and the decisions that separate good creative from launch ready creative.
blogPage.postBody2: Whether you are shipping a trailer, scaling a brand motion system, or building campaign visuals for a live product, the same principle applies: clarity of story first, polish second, and ruthless editing last. That discipline is how teams hit deadlines without the almost there feeling.
blogPage.postBody3: Want to apply this thinking to your next project? We would love to hear what you are building, send us a brief and we will map a cinematic path from concept to delivery.

privacyPage.metaDescription: Learn what information Starlights Visuals collects, why it is used, and how it is protected.
privacyPage.label: Your privacy
privacyPage.title: PRIVACY POLICY
privacyPage.subtitle: How our United States based studio handles information from clients and visitors around the world.
privacyPage.summary: We serve clients worldwide, with an important focus on Europe and Germany. We do not sell, rent, or trade personal information, and we never share one client's information with another client in the United States, Germany, Europe, or elsewhere.

information.title: Information we collect
information.body:
We collect only information you voluntarily submit. A project inquiry may include your name, email address, selected service, and message. A newsletter signup includes your email address. A submitted review may include your name, email address, role, company, rating, headline, and review text.

Our hosting and service providers may also process basic technical data, such as IP address, browser type, device information, request time, and error logs, to operate and secure the website.

use.title: How we use information
use.body:
We use submitted information to answer inquiries, prepare or provide requested creative services, send transactional replies, manage newsletter communications, review and publish testimonials with approval, maintain website security, prevent abuse, and comply with applicable law.

We do not use client project details or personal information for unrelated purposes.

sharing.title: When information is shared
sharing.body: We do not sell or rent personal information and do not disclose a client's information to clients in another country. Access is limited to Starlights Visuals and service providers that need the information to operate the website, communicate with you, or deliver requested work. Current providers include Supabase for database services, Resend for email delivery, and our website hosting provider. We may also disclose information when required by law or necessary to protect legal rights and website security.

international.title: Worldwide clients and international transfers
international.body:
Starlights Visuals operates from the United States and works with people worldwide, especially in Europe and Germany. United States client information is not shared with German or European clients, and German or European client information is not shared with United States clients.

This client separation does not mean data always remains inside one country. Our authorized team and cloud providers may process information in the United States, the European Economic Area, Germany, or other locations where they operate. When European personal data is transferred outside the European Economic Area, we use an applicable legal transfer mechanism where required, such as an adequacy decision, the EU Standard Contractual Clauses, or another safeguard recognized by law. See our EU GDPR Notice for additional details.

storage.title: Cookies and local storage
storage.body: This website currently does not use advertising cookies or third party analytics. It uses browser local storage to remember your language choice, translation prompt preference, and theme preference. This information stays on your device unless your browser clears it. Essential service infrastructure may use technical storage or logs necessary for security and operation.

retention.title: How long we keep information
retention.body: We keep inquiry and project information only as long as reasonably needed to respond, provide services, maintain business records, resolve disputes, and meet legal obligations. Newsletter information is kept until you unsubscribe or ask us to delete it. Review information is kept while the review is pending or published, unless removal is requested or retention is legally required.

rights.title: Your choices and privacy rights
rights.body: You may ask to access, correct, or delete personal information we hold about you, or object to certain uses. You may unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time by contacting us or using an unsubscribe option when provided. Depending on your United States state, additional privacy rights may apply. People in the European Economic Area, Germany, and the United Kingdom may also have rights under applicable European privacy law, as described in our EU GDPR Notice. We verify and respond to requests as required by applicable law and do not discriminate against anyone for exercising privacy rights.

children.title: Children's privacy
children.body: This website and our services are not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided information, contact us so we can delete it.

security.title: Security and international processing
security.body: We use reasonable administrative and technical safeguards designed to protect submitted information, including limiting access to people and providers that need it for a stated purpose. No internet transmission or storage system can be guaranteed completely secure.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: We may update this policy when our services, providers, or legal obligations change. The updated version will appear on this page with a revised date.

contact.title: Contact us
contact.body: For privacy questions or requests, email info@starlightvisualstudio.de. Please describe your request and the email address connected with the information so we can respond.

euGdprPage.metaDescription: GDPR information for people in the European Economic Area and Germany who interact with Starlights Visuals.
euGdprPage.label: European data protection
euGdprPage.title: EU GDPR NOTICE
euGdprPage.subtitle: Information for people in the European Economic Area and Germany.
euGdprPage.summary: Starlights Visuals is based in the United States and serves clients worldwide, especially in Europe and Germany. This notice supplements our Privacy Policy and explains how we handle personal data covered by the European Union General Data Protection Regulation.

scope.title: Scope
scope.body: This notice applies when the EU GDPR covers our processing of personal data, including when a person in the European Economic Area visits our website, contacts us about services, joins our newsletter, submits a review, or works with us on a project. It should be read together with our general Privacy Policy.

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body:
Starlights Visuals
United States
Email: info@starlightvisualstudio.de

Starlights Visuals determines why and how personal data submitted through this website is processed. Privacy and GDPR requests may be sent to the email address above.

data.title: Personal data we process
data.body: Depending on your interaction, we may process your name, email address, company, role, project type, project message, newsletter preference, review content and rating, correspondence, and basic technical data such as IP address, browser details, device information, timestamps, and security logs. We ask you not to send sensitive personal data unless it is necessary and specifically requested.

purposes.title: Purposes of processing
purposes.body: We process personal data to answer inquiries, take steps toward or perform a contract, deliver creative services, manage client communication, send requested newsletter messages, review and publish testimonials with approval, secure and maintain the website, prevent misuse, keep required business records, establish or defend legal claims, and comply with law.

legalBases.title: Legal bases
legalBases.body: Depending on the activity, we rely on one or more legal bases under Article 6 of the GDPR: steps requested before entering a contract or performance of a contract; consent for optional marketing and any activity that requires consent; our legitimate interests in responding to business inquiries, operating and securing our services, and managing client relationships, where those interests are not overridden by your rights; and compliance with legal obligations. You may withdraw consent at any time without affecting earlier lawful processing.

recipients.title: Recipients and client separation
recipients.body: We do not sell personal data. We do not share a United States client's information with clients in Germany or Europe, and we do not share a German or European client's information with clients in the United States. Personal data is available only to authorized Starlights Visuals personnel and providers that need it for a stated purpose, including Supabase for database services, Resend for email delivery, and our website hosting provider. Providers are expected to process data only under appropriate instructions and safeguards.

transfers.title: Transfers outside Europe
transfers.body: Because Starlights Visuals is based in the United States and uses international cloud services, European personal data may be transferred to or accessed from countries outside the European Economic Area, including the United States. Client separation does not prevent these necessary service transfers. Where the GDPR requires a transfer safeguard, we rely on an applicable adequacy decision, the EU Standard Contractual Clauses, the EU United States Data Privacy Framework for a participating provider, or another lawful mechanism. You may contact us for information about the safeguard relevant to your data.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: We keep personal data only as long as reasonably necessary for the purpose collected, including responding to inquiries, performing services, maintaining business and tax records, resolving disputes, and meeting legal obligations. Newsletter data is kept until you unsubscribe or request deletion. Review data is kept while pending or published unless removal is requested or retention is legally required.

rights.title: Your GDPR rights
rights.body: Subject to legal conditions and exceptions, you may request access to your personal data, correction, deletion, restriction of processing, data portability, or objection to processing based on legitimate interests or direct marketing. You may withdraw consent at any time. To exercise a right, email info@starlightvisualstudio.de. We may request information needed to verify your identity and will respond within the period required by law.

complaints.title: Right to complain
complaints.body: You may lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, particularly in the European Union member state where you live, work, or believe an infringement occurred. People in Germany may contact the competent German federal state data protection authority.

decisions.title: Automated decisions and required data
decisions.body: We do not use submitted personal data for solely automated decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects. Fields marked as required are needed to answer an inquiry or provide the requested function. If required information is not provided, we may be unable to respond or deliver that function.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For GDPR questions, rights requests, transfer safeguard information, or privacy concerns, email info@starlightvisualstudio.de.

responsibility.title: Responsibility for content
responsibility.body: We make reasonable efforts to keep the information on this website accurate and current. However, we do not guarantee that all content is complete, error free, or continuously available. Website content is provided for general information and does not constitute legal, financial, or other professional advice.

links.title: External links
links.body: This website may link to third party websites or platforms. We do not control their content, availability, or privacy practices and are not responsible for them. The operator of each linked service is responsible for its own content.

copyright.title: Copyright
copyright.body: Unless otherwise stated, the text, design, animation, artwork, video, and other original content on this website are owned by Starlights Visuals or used with permission. Reproduction, distribution, or commercial use requires prior written permission, except where applicable law allows otherwise.
